ui.low_sample_warning: Low sample: only {n} match(es) so far — treat these numbers as a hint.
ui.practice_hint: Paste into the practice-server console; requires sv_cheats 1.
ui.setup_shape_help: A2 M2 B1 means 2 at A, 2 at mid, 1 at B; S is T spawn and C is CT spawn.
ui.data_source_note: Data source: professional match demos (IEM Cologne Major 2026 and more, via the cs2povarchive dataset on Hugging Face).

role_desc.awper: The team's main AWPer, holding angles and hunting opening kills.
role_desc.a_anchor: Holds the A site, delaying the attack until teammates can rotate.
role_desc.b_anchor: Holds the B site, delaying the attack until teammates can rotate.
role_desc.mid_ct: Takes mid at the start, gathering info and supporting both sites.
role_desc.lurker: Plays alone behind the enemy, rarely moving with the pack.
role_desc.entry: First into the site on T side, opening up the round.
role_desc.support: Throws the most utility, setting up teammates.

metric_desc.dpr: Deaths per round; lower is safer.
metric_desc.hs_pct: Share of kills that are headshots.
metric_desc.opening_kills_pr: Opening kills the player gets per round.
metric_desc.opening_deaths_pr: How often the player is their team's first death.
metric_desc.traded_death_rate: Share of deaths immediately avenged by a teammate.
metric_desc.awp_share: Share of rounds holding the AWP.
metric_desc.avg_dist_to_team_30s: Average distance to teammates at 30s; farther means more lurking.
metric_desc.first_into_site_rate: Share of site takes where the player enters first.
metric_desc.opening_win_rate: Win rate in the round's first duel.
metric_desc.avg_first_kill_s: Average second into the round when the first kill happens.
metric_desc.avg_early_util: Utility used in the first 15 seconds for map control.
metric_desc.retake_win_rate: Share of retakes won after the bomb was planted.
metric_desc.stack_rate_15s: Share of CT rounds with 3+ players stacked on one site at 15s.
metric_desc.round_win_rate: Win rate of the rounds where this was used.
metric_desc.n_throws: How many times pros threw this lineup.
metric_desc.median_pop_t_s: Typical second into the round when the utility pops.
metric_desc.ct_lane_15s_share: Share of CT rounds spent in this lane at 15s.
metric_desc.t_avg_dist_to_team_30s: Average T-side distance to teammates at 30s.
metric_desc.t_first_into_site_rate: Share of T-side site takes entered first.

heatmap.title: Heatmaps
heatmap.to_lineup: Learn the throw in the lineup library
heatmap.help: Colors identify players; deeper shades mean a player appears there more often. Data includes living time in gun rounds for both teams, excluding the first 5 seconds and time after the round ends. Presence shows time spent, holding shows nearly stationary time, fights combine shots, kills and deaths, and utility shows grenade landings. Utility shows landing points only; visit the lineup library to learn the throws.

tactics.description: Gun rounds only. Compare attacking patterns and defensive setups, then open a utility spot to learn its most-used lineup.
tactics.far_players: Average players on the other site
tactics.pre_rotated: Average change on target before commit
tactics.radar_help: Numbers match the spot lists. Faded icons with dashed outlines are optional. Smoke and fire areas show approximate coverage; walls and height can change their shape.
tactics.radar_unavailable: Radar image unavailable; utility markers and spot links are still available.
tactics.map_hint: Open a numbered spot to learn the throw.
tactics.no_spots: No utility positions available for this selection.
tactics.no_scale: Effect areas are unavailable because the map scale could not be loaded.
tactics.target_context: {site} — share of all T gun rounds.
tactics.commit_context: Elapsed round time when the attack commits to a site.
tactics.setup_context: Round wins with the most common setup at 20 s.
tactics.forward_context: Gun rounds with at least one CT in forward territory at 15 s.
tactics.stack_context: Gun rounds with a site stack at 20 s.
tactics.ct_utility_context: The map shows the six most-thrown CT spots for the site filter, across all setups. Setup rows describe the whole defense at 20 s; utility is not attributed to individual setups.
tactics.preview_hint: Hover or focus to preview; click to select and expand.
